properties.reasoning: The Babícora estate, Hearst's ranch, lay across the municipios of Temósachic, Namiquipa, Madera and Gómez Farías (plan section 2.4). This outline is those four municipios joined, from today's boundaries; the estate itself was about a fifth of this area and its legal bounds are not known to this project.
